s:
Consider the following statements about the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2025:
1. It is published by Transparency International, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Berlin.
2. It covered 182 countries on a 0–100 scale using 13 data sources.
3. India ranked 96th with a score of 39, slipping five places from its 2024 rank of 91st.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: India ranked 91st (score 39), up five places from 96th in 2024. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Match the countries in the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 with their scores:
List-I (Country)
a. Denmark (1st, 8th year on top)
b. Finland (2nd)
c. Singapore (3rd)
d. South Sudan (bottom)
List-II (Score)
i. 84
ii. 89
iii. 9
iv. 88
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: Denmark (1st, 8th year on top) – 89; Finland (2nd) – 88; Singapore (3rd) – 84; South Sudan (bottom) – 9 (a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii). Singapore scored 84, not 88 (Finland's score).

s:
Consider the following statements about the Henley Passport Index 2026 (January 2026):
1. It is published by Henley & Partners using IATA data.
2. India ranked 85th, down from 80th in 2025.
3. Singapore ranked first with access to 192 destinations.
4. Although India's rank improved, the number of destinations its passport could access fell from 57 to 55.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: India ranked 80th, up five places from 85th in 2025. Statement 3 is correct. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 1, 3 and 4 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Responsible Nations Index 2026:
1. It is the first edition, brought out by the World Intellectual Foundation, New Delhi.
2. It was launched by former President Pranab Mukherjee at the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre.
3. Singapore ranked first and India 16th among 154 countries.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 2 of the 3 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: it was launched by ex-President Ram Nath Kovind. Statement 3 is correct.

s:
Match the countries with their ranks in the Global Firepower Index 2026:
List-I (Country)
a. Russia
b. India
c. Pakistan
d. Bhutan
List-II (Rank)
i. 4
ii. 145 (last)
iii. 2
iv. 14
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: Russia – 2; India – 4; Pakistan – 14; Bhutan – 145 (last) (a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii). USA, Russia and China are the top three; India is 4th.

s:
Assertion (A): The USA ranked first in the Global Firepower Index 2026 with the lowest PowerIndex score.
Reason (R): In the Global Firepower Index, which uses 60+ parameters, a lower score means a stronger military.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both are true: the USA tops the Global Firepower Index 2026, and in this index a lower score indicates a stronger military, which is exactly why the top-ranked country has the lowest score. So R explains A.

s:
Match the categories of Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 with their first-ranked winners:
List-I (Category)
a. 10 lakh+ population
b. 3–10 lakh population
c. Best Ganga Town
d. Promising Swachh Shehar (AP)
List-II (Winner)
i. Rajahmundry
ii. Prayagraj
iii. Ahmedabad
iv. Noida
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: 10 lakh+ population – Ahmedabad; 3–10 lakh population – Noida; Best Ganga Town – Prayagraj; Promising Swachh Shehar (AP) – Rajahmundry (a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i). Prayagraj was also honoured for Mahakumbh 2025; in SS 2023 the best Ganga town was Varanasi.

s:
Consider the following statements about Swachh Survekshan 2024-25:
1. It was the 9th edition, conducted by MoHUA, with awards given by President Droupadi Murmu.
2. Indore, Surat and Navi Mumbai were placed in the new Super Swachh League.
3. Indore was declared the cleanest city for the 7th year.
4. Vijayawada of Andhra Pradesh was also inducted into the Super Swachh League (10 lakh+).
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Indore was cleanest for the 8th year. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 3 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about city rankings released in 2025–26:
1. In the Numbeo Safety Index 2026, Mangaluru was India's safest city, while Qingdao topped globally.
2. In the TomTom Traffic Index 2025, Bengaluru was ranked the world's most congested city.
3. The QS Best Student Cities 2026 named New Delhi the most affordable student city.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: Mexico City was 1st; Bengaluru was 2nd (3rd in 2024) with a congested speed of 16.6 km/h. Statement 3 is correct. Hence the answer is 1 and 3 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the latest world university rankings:
1. In the QS World University Rankings 2027, IIT Delhi was the top Indian institution at 118th.
2. In the QS World University Rankings 2027, MIT was 1st and 52 Indian institutions featured.
3. In the THE World University Rankings 2027, IIT Bombay was the top Indian institution.
4. Oxford topped the THE World University Rankings 2027 for the 11th year.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 3 of the 4 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: IISc Bengaluru (joint 254th) was the top Indian institution. Statement 4 is correct.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Network Readiness Index (NRI):
1. It is published by the Portulans Institute, Washington DC.
2. India ranked 45th of 127 in NRI 2025, up from 49th of 133 in NRI 2024.
3. Infrastructure is one of its four pillars.
4. In NRI 2025, India ranked 1st in FTTH (fibre-to-the-home).
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the four pillars are Technology, People, Governance and Impact. Statement 4 is wrong: India was 2nd in FTTH; it was 1st in telecom service investment, AI scientific publications and ICT service exports. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026:
1. It is the 3rd edition, published by Dezan Shira & Associates (Hong Kong).
2. It covers 11 Asian countries on 8 pillars.
3. Vietnam ranked first, followed by China and Malaysia.
4. India ranked 6th.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 3 of the 4 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the order is 1. China, 2. Malaysia, 3. Vietnam. Statement 4 is correct.

s:
Assertion (A): India ranked 2nd in the LEED rankings 2025 for countries outside the US, with 611 projects.
Reason (R): The LEED rating framework is developed and certified by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE).
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: A is true: India was 2nd (611 projects) after Mainland China. R is false: the LEED framework is by USGBC and certification is by GBCI, not BEE.

s:
Consider the following statements about UNEP's Global Environment Outlook (GEO-7), 2025:
1. It is UNEP's 7th GEO, released at UNEP's 7th session in Nairobi.
2. It reported that the global temperature in 2024 was 1.55°C, the highest ever.
3. It estimated about 7 million premature deaths a year from pollution.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: GEO-7 puts pollution deaths at 9 million a year. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the projections of UNEP's GEO-7:
1. The 1.5°C threshold is likely to be breached by the early 2030s.
2. The 2°C threshold is likely to be crossed by the 2060s.
3. Food-system transformation could lift 200 million people out of undernutrition and 100 million out of extreme poverty.
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: GEO-7 projects 2°C by the 2040s. Statement 3 is correct. Hence the answer is 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP):
1. It was founded on 5 June 1972 and is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.
2. It brings out the Emissions Gap Report, the Frontiers Report and the Global Environment Outlook.
3. Its Common Carbon Metric measures the carbon footprint of the transport sector.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the Common Carbon Metric measures the carbon footprint of building operations. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about UNEP's State of Finance for Nature 2026:
1. For every USD 1 spent on protecting nature, about USD 30 goes to nature-degrading activities.
2. Nature-negative finance flows were about USD 7.3 trillion in 2023.
3. Spending on biodiversity fell by 11%.
4. India's Nature-based Solutions initiatives cited include MISHTI, Amrit Sarovar and CAMPA funds.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: biodiversity spending rose by 11%. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 4 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the IQAir World Air Quality Report 2025:
1. Pakistan was the most polluted country, followed by Bangladesh.
2. India was the 6th most polluted country, having been 5th in 2024.
3. Loni (Ghaziabad) was the world's most polluted city, and 5 Indian cities were in the world's top 10.
4. Dhaka was the most polluted capital for the 8th year running.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is correct. Statement 4 is wrong: New Delhi has been the most polluted capital for the 8th year. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 3 only.

s:
Match the reports (2026) with the figures they gave:
List-I (Report)
a. IMF WEO Update (Jan 2026) – India's FY27 growth
b. UN WESP 2026 – India's 2026 growth
c. IMF WEO Update – global growth 2026
d. ILO Employment and Social Trends 2026 – global unemployment
List-II (Figure)
i. 4.9%
ii. 6.4%
iii. 3.3%
iv. 6.6%
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: IMF WEO Update (Jan 2026) – India's FY27 growth – 6.4%; UN WESP 2026 – India's 2026 growth – 6.6%; IMF WEO Update – global growth 2026 – 3.3%; ILO Employment and Social Trends 2026 – global unemployment – 4.9% (a-ii, b-iv, c-iii, d-i). UN WESP 2026 (UN DESA) called India the fastest-growing major economy.

s:
Consider the following statements about the WEF Global Risks Report 2026:
1. It is the 21st edition, assessing 33 risks.
2. Its top short-term risk is geo-economic confrontation.
3. Its most severe long-term risk is adverse outcomes of AI technologies.
4. India's top risk was identified as cyber insecurity.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 3 of the 4 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the most severe long-term risk is biodiversity loss and ecosystem collapse; AI adverse outcomes rank 5th. Statement 4 is correct.

s:
Match the reports with the organisations that publish them:
List-I (Report)
a. World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026
b. Employment and Social Trends 2026
c. Women, Business and the Law 2026
d. Global Risks Report 2026
List-II (Publisher)
i. World Bank
ii. World Economic Forum
iii. ILO
iv. UN DESA
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026 – UN DESA; Employment and Social Trends 2026 – ILO; Women, Business and the Law 2026 – World Bank; Global Risks Report 2026 – World Economic Forum (a-iv, b-iii, c-i, d-ii). The World Bank also brings out the Container Port Performance Index (nine Indian ports).

s:
Consider the following statements about the NITI Aayog Export Preparedness Index (EPI) 2024, released in January 2026:
1. Maharashtra ranked first among large States, followed by Tamil Nadu.
2. Andhra Pradesh rose from 20th in 2020 to 5th in 2024.
3. Telangana ranked 3rd among large States.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Gujarat was 3rd; Telangana was 8th. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Assertion (A): Business environment carries the highest weight (40%) among the pillars of NITI Aayog's Export Preparedness Index.
Reason (R): The Export Preparedness Index is linked to India's goal of USD 1 trillion in exports by 2030.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both are true: business environment is the highest-weight pillar (40%), and the index is tied to the USD 1 trillion export goal for 2030. But the export goal does not explain why one pillar gets the most weight, so R is not the explanation of A.

s:
Match the rankings with the States that topped them:
List-I (Ranking)
a. Panchayat Advancement Index 2.0
b. ICJS 2.0 ranking of NCRB (Dec 2025)
c. Wool production 2023–24
d. Installed renewable capacity (Dec 2025)
List-II (Top State)
i. Uttarakhand
ii. Tripura
iii. Gujarat
iv. Rajasthan
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: Panchayat Advancement Index 2.0 – Tripura; ICJS 2.0 ranking of NCRB (Dec 2025) – Uttarakhand; Wool production 2023–24 – Rajasthan; Installed renewable capacity (Dec 2025) – Gujarat (a-ii, b-i, c-iv, d-iii). Tripura scored 88.44, Uttarakhand Police 93.46; Rajasthan has 47.5% of wool; Gujarat had 42.58 GW.

s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh in recent State rankings:
1. In the States' Electricity Transition Report 2026 (IEEFA–Ember), Andhra Pradesh led the market-enablers dimension with Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.
2. Andhra Pradesh was 2nd in tobacco production in 2024–25, after Gujarat.
3. As per PLFS 2023–24, Bihar recorded the lowest literacy rate, with Andhra Pradesh second lowest.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Andhra Pradesh recorded the lowest literacy rate (72.6%); Bihar was 2nd lowest. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the RBI report on population ageing:
1. A State is classified as 'ageing' when the share of people aged 60+ exceeds 15%.
2. Andhra Pradesh's 60+ share is 14.1% (2026) and it is expected to become an ageing State by 2031.
3. Telangana ranks 5th on the ageing indicators.
4. Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh are classified as young States.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Andhra Pradesh is 5th and Telangana 10th. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 4 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about recent studies on diabetes:
1. As per the Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology study (2024 data), China has the most adults with diabetes (148 million) and India is 2nd (~90 million).
2. The same study put the world total at 589 million.
3. The Nature Medicine study (2020–2050) projected that India would bear the highest economic burden from diabetes.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the highest burden is the US (USD 16.5 trillion); India 11.4 and China 11. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the CEEW report 'Cattle and Community in a Changing Climate (2026)':
1. It found that 38% of cattle rearers do not sell milk.
2. Indigenous cattle emit about 43 kg of methane a year, more than crossbred cattle (about 28 kg).
3. Buffaloes give over 50% of India's milk.
4. The dairy sector contributes about 5% of India's GDP.
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: it is the reverse: crossbred ~43 kg/yr, indigenous ~28 kg. Statement 3 is correct. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 2 only.

s:
Assertion (A): Investment scams accounted for only about a quarter of the losses from cyber crime in India in 2025.
Reason (R): India reported 28.15 lakh cyber crime cases in 2025.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: A is false: investment scams made up about 76% of cyber-crime losses in 2025. R is true: 28.15 lakh cyber crime cases were reported in 2025.

s:

List-I (Index)
a. World Competitiveness Ranking
b. World Press Freedom Index
c. Global Hunger Index
d. Global Peace Index
List-II (Publisher)
i. Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe
ii. IMD Business School, Lausanne
iii. Institute for Economics & Peace, Sydney
iv. Reporters Without Borders (RSF)
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: World Competitiveness Ranking – IMD Business School, Lausanne; World Press Freedom Index – Reporters Without Borders (RSF); Global Hunger Index – Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe; Global Peace Index – Institute for Economics & Peace, Sydney (a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii).

s:
Match the 2025 indices with India's rank in them:
List-I (Index (2025))
a. Human Development Report (UNDP)
b. Global Innovation Index (WIPO)
c. Global Gender Gap Index (WEF)
d. Global Hunger Index
List-II (India's rank)
i. 102nd of 123
ii. 131st of 148
iii. 38th of 139
iv. 130th of 193
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: Human Development Report (UNDP) – 130th of 193; Global Innovation Index (WIPO) – 38th of 139; Global Gender Gap Index (WEF) – 131st of 148; Global Hunger Index – 102nd of 123 (a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i). In the Global Gender Gap Index India slipped from 129th (2024) to 131st.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Human Development Report 2025:
1. Its theme is 'A Matter of Choice: People and Possibilities in the Age of AI'.
2. India's HDI value is 0.685, placing it in the medium human development category.
3. Switzerland ranked first.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Iceland (0.972) is 1st in HDR 2025; Switzerland topped HDR 2023-24. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Global Peace Index 2025:
1. It is published by the Institute for Economics & Peace, Sydney, using 23 indicators in three domains.
2. Iceland has been 1st since 2008, and Singapore was the only Asian country in the top 10.
3. Afghanistan was ranked last.
4. It found state-based conflicts at their highest level since World War II.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 3 of the 4 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Russia was ranked last (163rd). Statement 4 is correct.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Critical and Emerging Technologies (CET) Index:
1. It covers 25 countries and is based on classified intelligence data.
2. Semiconductors carry the highest weight (35%) and quantum the lowest (5%).
3. Artificial intelligence carries a weight of 25%.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is wrong: it uses public and commercial data, not classified data. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is correct. Hence the answer is 2 and 3 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI):
1. It is published by Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and Climate Action Network, and has been published since 2005.
2. CCPI 2026 covers 63 countries plus the European Union.
3. Renewable Energy carries the highest weight (40%) among its four categories.
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: GHG Emissions carries 40%; Renewable Energy, Energy Use and Climate Policy carry 20% each. Hence the answer is 3 only.

s:
Assertion (A): India fell 13 places to 23rd in the Climate Change Performance Index 2026.
Reason (R): India has announced a coal-exit timeline of 2040 and stopped auctioning new coal blocks.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: A is true: India fell 13 places to 23rd. R is false: the report faulted India precisely because it has no coal-exit timeline and is auctioning new coal blocks.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Production Gap Report 2025 (22 September 2025):
1. It was released by SEI, Climate Analytics and IISD.
2. Planned 2030 fossil-fuel output is over 120% above the level consistent with 1.5°C.
3. Coal should approach phase-out by 2050.
4. Nigeria doubled its 2030 oil production target.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the report says coal should be near phase-out by 2040. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 4 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the AIGCC Just Transition Report 2025:
1. It identifies India as the world's 3rd largest emitter.
2. It names Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Odisha as the at-risk coal States.
3. It recommends State-level transition plans.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 2 of the 3 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: it recommends district-level transition plans.

s:
Consider the following statements about the WMO State of the Climate in Asia 2024:
1. It was released by the WMO, whose Secretary-General is Celeste Saulo.
2. Asia is warming at twice the global average.
3. Sea-level rise on the Pacific and Indian Ocean sides of Asia is below the global average.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: sea-level rise there is above the global average. Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Match the 2024 extreme events (WMO State of the Climate in Asia 2024) with their details:
List-I (Event)
a. UAE
b. Wayanad (Kerala)
c. Cyclone Remal
d. Cyclone Asna
List-II (Detail)
i. Over 500 mm in 48 hours, 350+ deaths
ii. Arabian Sea, August 2024, hit Oman
iii. 259.5 mm in 24 hours, most since 1949
iv. Bay of Bengal, May 2024
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: UAE – 259.5 mm in 24 hours, most since 1949; Wayanad (Kerala) – Over 500 mm in 48 hours, 350+ deaths; Cyclone Remal – Bay of Bengal, May 2024; Cyclone Asna – Arabian Sea, August 2024, hit Oman (a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii).

s:
Consider the following statements about India's natural sites in the IUCN World Heritage Outlook 4 (2025):
1. Khangchendzonga National Park is the only Indian site rated 'Good'.
2. Manas National Park and Sundarbans National Park are rated 'Significant concern'.
3. India has eight natural World Heritage sites.
4. The only 'Critical' site in Asia is the Tropical Rainforest Heritage of Sumatra, and the top threat is climate change.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: India has seven natural World Heritage sites. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 4 only.

s:
Match the health and air-pollution reports (2025) with the bodies that prepared them:
List-I (Report)
a. State of Global Air 2025
b. Lancet Countdown 2025
c. Air Quality Life Index 2025
d. Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2025
List-II (Prepared by)
i. CPCB
ii. University College London with WHO
iii. Health Effects Institute and IHME
iv. EPIC, University of Chicago
Select the correct answer:
x: Correct pairs: State of Global Air 2025 – Health Effects Institute and IHME; Lancet Countdown 2025 – University College London with WHO; Air Quality Life Index 2025 – EPIC, University of Chicago; Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2025 – CPCB (a-iii, b-ii, c-iv, d-i).

s:
Consider the following statements about the State of Global Air (SoGA) 2025 report:
1. India recorded about 2 million air-pollution deaths in 2023.
2. India's death rate was 186 per 100,000, against 17 in high-income countries.
3. SDG target 3.4, cited in it, aims to halve premature non-communicable disease deaths by 2030.
4. Maharashtra was among the States with over 1 lakh deaths.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: SDG 3.4 aims to cut premature NCD deaths by one-third by 2030. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 4 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Lancet Countdown 2025 findings on India:
1. India records about 1.72 million deaths a year from anthropogenic PM2.5.
2. India recorded 419 extra heatwave hours per person.
3. The area affected by extreme drought rose by 138%.
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: it was 366 extra heatwave hours per person; 419 is the lost labour hours. Statement 3 is correct. Hence the answer is 2 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Air Quality Life Index (AQLI) 2025:
1. About 46% of Indians live in areas above the Indian PM2.5 standard of 40 µg/m³.
2. The Indo-Gangetic Plain is the most polluted region of India.
3. Delhi would gain 8.2 years of life expectancy if the WHO limit were met.
4. Pakistan was identified as the most polluted country.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is correct. Statement 4 is wrong: AQLI names Bangladesh as the most polluted country. Hence the answer is 1, 2 and 3 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the CEEW district-level heat-risk study:
1. Andhra Pradesh is ranked the most heat-risk-prone State.
2. 57% of India's districts are at high or very high heat risk.
3. 70% of Andhra Pradesh's districts have five or more extra very warm nights.
4. The heat-island cities it lists are Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Kurnool.
How many of the above statements are correct?
x: 3 of the 4 statements are correct. Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is correct. Statement 4 is wrong: the heat islands named are Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Rajahmundry, Tirupati and Guntur.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Sustainable Development Report (SDG Index) 2025:
1. It is brought out by the UN SDSN, whose team is led by Jeffrey Sachs.
2. India ranked 99th of 167, entering the top 100 for the first time.
3. India had ranked 112th in 2022.
4. Finland topped the index and Benin was the fastest improver.
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: India was 121st in 2022 and 112th in 2023. Statement 4 is correct. Hence the answer is 3 only.

s:
Consider the following statements about the India Justice Report (IJR):
1. It was initiated by the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and first published in 2019.
2. It ranks States on four pillars – police, judiciary, prisons and legal aid.
3. Andhra Pradesh was ranked 5th in 2019 and 13th in 2022.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct. Statement 3 is wrong: it is the reverse: AP was 13th in 2019 and 5th in 2022 (2nd in 2025). Hence the answer is 1 and 2 only.

s:
Assertion (A): As per the India Justice Report 2025, women make up 22% of Andhra Pradesh's police, the highest share among States.
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh spends ₹2.6 lakh per prison inmate, the highest among States.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Both are true as per IJR 2025: AP has the highest share of women in police (22%) and the highest prison spend per inmate (₹2.6 lakh). But prison spending does not explain the share of women in the police, so R does not explain A.
